arguments.content:
-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv:
--   A -> gold
--   B -> silver
--   C -> bronze

-- 1. Add the new loyalty column.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

-- 2. Backfill it from legacy_code using the codes.csv mapping.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

-- 3. Replace legacy_code values with the tier names from codes.csv.
UPDATE customers SET legacy_code = 'gold'   WHERE legacy_code = 'A';
UPDATE customers SET legacy_code = 'silver' WHERE legacy_code = 'B';
UPDATE customers SET legacy_code = 'bronze' WHERE legacy_code = 'C';
